verdict.rationale: Datadog documents APM/tracing, Log Management and metrics dashboards as first-party products in one platform. A hands-on customer confirms that its main advantage is correlating APM, custom metrics and logs through shared tagging that is densely linked across the platform. One critic calls the correlation worse than Honeycomb or Dynatrace, but that is a comparative opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the cross-signal pivot mechanics (e.g. trace-to-log linking and unified tagging), broader independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: correlating data across APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging, densely linked across the platform
